newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank cuts repo rate to 5.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank cuts repo rate to 5.15 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday cut its repo rate, its key tool for controlling money market liquidity, to 5.15 percent from 5.25 percent.
The fixed reverse repurchase tender will run for seven days from September 11 to September 18 and replaces a seven-day operation at a rate of 5.25 percent.
The central bank last cut its repo rate to 5.25 percent from 5.40 percent on August 27.
In a Reuter survey 14 out of 18 analysts expected the Riksbank to cut the repo rate by 15 basis points while the other four forecast a 10 basis points cut.
